methods.label: Check the definition
methods.explanation: A system of linear equations in two variables must contain two unknowns in total, and each equation must be linear. An individual equation may contain only one of the unknowns. In A, the degree of \(xy\) is 2; in B, the degree of \(x^2\) is 2; D contains three unknowns. In C, both equations are linear and the only unknowns are \(x\) and \(y\). Therefore, the answer is C.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 definitions of linear equations and systems, together with monomial degree.
